generic_sampling_rules.text_short: Sample from a small pool of realistic short strings; 5% near-variants (case flip, trailing ' x', one-char typo) of pool values; 2% NULL when nullable.
generic_sampling_rules.text_long: Sample from a pool of 8-12 realistic sentences; 20-50% duplicate share on DISTINCT-targeted columns; 2% NULL when nullable.
generic_sampling_rules.int_quantity: Uniform integer in [0, 200]; 1% NULL when nullable.
generic_sampling_rules.real_rating: Uniform real in [1.0, 5.0] rounded to 1 decimal; 1% NULL when nullable.
generic_sampling_rules.text_id: Format '<prefix>_<8 hex>'; 20-50% duplicate share on DISTINCT-targeted columns; 2% NULL when nullable.
generic_sampling_rules.text_lat_lon: Numeric string with 6 decimals, e.g. '32.776664'; 2% NULL when nullable.
generic_sampling_rules.text_address: Street number + street + city + state + zip; 2% NULL when nullable.
generic_sampling_rules.boundary_numeric: For each listed literal L and step s: include L-s, L, L+s.
generic_sampling_rules.boundary_text: For each listed literal L: include L, lower(L), upper(L), and one-char-typo variant.
generic_sampling_rules.like_variant: For each listed LIKE literal '%X%': include X, X+' x', one-char-typo of X, lower(X).
generic_sampling_rules.null_share: Every nullable column: at least one NULL row per instance; share ~2% (5% for join FK columns).
generic_sampling_rules.join_fk: 5% of child rows get NULL FK; 5% of parent rows have no child rows.
generic_sampling_rules.tie_order: For ORDER/LIMIT-targeted columns, plant at least 3 rows sharing the max value.
